title: COLD STORAGE: Returning series of 8 short stories
description:
COLD STORAGE is a series of short stories spanning the world of crypto trading and

NFT’s. Using the novel medium of ‘Screenlife’ - stories told solely through computer

screens - COLD STORAGE explores the vast online communities of internationally

diverse individuals as they all seek to capitalise on the ‘crypto rush’. The first story in the

series follows a small group of friends as they try to identify the owner of a hacked

crypto wallet during a live ‘heist’. As they discover more about the victim of the heist,

their allegiances and morals are tested as they debate whether to alert the victim or try

and claim some of the quarry for themselves.


Available Materials: Pitch Deck / Treatment.
